note: IR error registry (plan §6). Append-only: never renumber, rename, remove or reuse a code; set "deprecated": true instead. All text is our own wording.

codes.name: ConfigMissing
codes.message: The server configuration is missing or invalid.
codes.hint: Set the IMAGERIGHT_* environment variables or fix the config file, then call ir_get_config to confirm.

codes.name: UnsupportedVersion
codes.message: That ImageRight version is not one this server has a catalog for.
codes.hint: Use 24.x, 25.x or 7.2 (or an exact 24.2 / 25.1).

codes.name: BaseUrlMissing
codes.message: No base URL is configured for the surface this call needs.
codes.hint: Set the REST or SOAP URL for your ImageRight server; ir_get_config shows what is set.

codes.name: ServerVersionMismatch
codes.message: The server reports a different ImageRight version than the one configured.
codes.hint: Update IMAGERIGHT_VERSION to match the server so the right catalog profile is used.

codes.name: ProfileApproximated
codes.message: The requested version has no exact catalog profile, so the closest one is used.
codes.hint: Results may miss small differences; check ir_compare_versions if something looks off.

codes.name: SurfaceDisabled
codes.message: The surface this call needs is switched off in the configuration.
codes.hint: Enable it in the surface preference, or pick an operation on another surface.

codes.name: FileOutsideAllowedRoot
codes.message: The local file path is outside the folders this server may read or write.
codes.hint: Move the file under an allowed root or extend the allowed roots in the config.

codes.name: InvalidCredentials
codes.message: The user name or password was rejected.
codes.hint: Check the credentials; ImageRight user names and passwords are case-sensitive.

codes.name: AccountLocked
codes.message: The account is locked.
codes.hint: An administrator must unlock it; retrying with the same credentials keeps it locked.

codes.name: PasswordExpired
codes.message: The password has expired.
codes.hint: Set a new password (for example through the change-password operation) and sign in again.

codes.name: TokenExpired
codes.message: The session token has expired.
codes.hint: Sign in again to get a fresh token, then repeat the call if it was a read.

codes.name: InvalidToken
codes.message: The session token was not accepted.
codes.hint: Check the auth mode and token format in the config; a freshly issued token being refused means the auth setup is wrong.

codes.name: TenantAccessForbidden
codes.message: The caller has no access to the requested tenant, or the tenant header is missing.
codes.hint: Check the tenant id sent with the request and the user's tenant membership.

codes.name: SoapSessionExpired
codes.message: The SOAP session ended before the call finished.
codes.hint: The outcome of a write is unknown: verify the object's state before retrying. Reads are replayed automatically.

codes.name: ApiKeyProblem
codes.message: The API key is missing, wrong, or not set up on the server.
codes.hint: Check the API key header and the server's API key configuration.

codes.name: PasswordPolicy
codes.message: The new password breaks the password rules.
codes.hint: Pick a password that meets the complexity and history rules, or ask an administrator whether changes are allowed.

codes.name: AccountRecoveryFailed
codes.message: The password-reset request could not be completed.
codes.hint: Check that the user has an email and security questions set up, and that the reset link is fresh.

codes.name: UnknownOperation
codes.message: No operation matches that identifier.
codes.hint: Use ir_search_apis to find the operationId, or pick one of the suggestions.

codes.name: OperationNotAvailableInVersion
codes.message: The operation does not exist in the selected version.
codes.hint: Check ir_check_availability for the versions that have it, or use a replacement.

codes.name: OperationDeprecated
codes.message: The operation is deprecated.
codes.hint: Switch to the replacement listed by ir_list_deprecations.

codes.name: NoSurfaceAvailable
codes.message: No enabled surface can serve this request in the selected version.
codes.hint: Check the surface preference and ir_check_availability.

codes.name: MissingRequiredParam
codes.message: A required argument is missing.
codes.hint: Call ir_describe_api for {operationId} to see which arguments are required.

codes.name: InvalidParamValue
codes.message: An argument has a value this tool cannot use.
codes.hint: Check the allowed values in the tool description or the suggestions.

codes.name: ParamNotAvailableInVersion
codes.message: The parameter does not exist in the selected version.
codes.hint: Drop it, or check ir_check_availability for versions that accept it.

codes.name: WriteBlockedByPolicy
codes.message: The configured write mode does not allow this call.
codes.hint: Change the write mode in the config if the change is intended, or use dry-run to preview it.

codes.name: PreviewMismatch
codes.message: The confirmation does not match the previewed request.
codes.hint: Preview the call again and confirm with the new id.

codes.name: UnknownErrorReference
codes.message: No IR code, native error code, error name or known fault text matches that input.
codes.hint: Pass an IR code (IR-4301), a native REST code (201), a native or IR error name, or the SOAP fault text.

codes.name: ObjectNotFound
codes.message: The {objectKind} was not found.
codes.hint: Check the id; it may have been deleted or may belong to another drawer or tenant.

codes.name: AccountNotFound
codes.message: The user, group or role was not found.
codes.hint: Look the account up by name first and use the id it returns.

codes.name: WorkflowOrStepNotFound
codes.message: The workflow, step or step link was not found.
codes.hint: List the workflow's steps and links to get valid ids.

codes.name: TaskNotFound
codes.message: The task was not found.
codes.hint: The task may have completed or been deleted; search tasks again to get a current id.

codes.name: PageNotFound
codes.message: The page was not found.
codes.hint: List the document's pages to get current page ids.

codes.name: TypeNotFound
codes.message: The type definition (file, folder, document, note type or drawer) was not found.
codes.hint: List the available types and use one of their ids.

codes.name: AttributeNotFound
codes.message: The attribute or attribute value was not found.
codes.hint: Check the attribute definitions for this {objectKind} type.

codes.name: ConfigPathNotFound
codes.message: The configuration path was not found.
codes.hint: List the parent configuration node to see which paths exist.

codes.name: InvalidData
codes.message: The request data is invalid or incomplete.
codes.hint: Compare the request with ir_describe_api for {operationId}; a field is empty, malformed or out of range.

codes.name: AttributeRequired
codes.message: A mandatory attribute has no value.
codes.hint: Call ir_describe_api for {operationId} to see mandatory attributes, then set them first.

codes.name: AttributeNotAllowed
codes.message: The attribute or mark is not allowed on this {objectKind} type.
codes.hint: Use only the attributes and marks defined for the type.

codes.name: AttributeValueInvalid
codes.message: An attribute value has the wrong type or format.
codes.hint: Check the attribute's data type and allowed values.

codes.name: WrongObjectClass
codes.message: The id points to a different kind of object than this call expects.
codes.hint: Check that the id is a {objectKind} and not, say, a folder or document id.

codes.name: TemplateViolation
codes.message: The change is not allowed by the file type's template.
codes.hint: Check which document and folder types the parent's template allows.

codes.name: InvalidTarget
codes.message: The target of the move, copy or link is not valid.
codes.hint: Source and target must be in the same file where required, and the target must exist and be local.

codes.name: ImageMissing
codes.message: The page image is missing, empty or unreadable.
codes.hint: Send at least one non-empty image in a supported format.

codes.name: SplitParamsInvalid
codes.message: The task split parameters are missing or invalid.
codes.hint: Check the split parameters against the step's split settings.

codes.name: AlreadyExists
codes.message: An object with the same key or name already exists.
codes.hint: Look up the existing object and reuse it, or choose a different name.

codes.name: ConfigNodeInvalid
codes.message: The configuration change does not fit the node's type or position.
codes.hint: Read the target node first and match its type (section or key).

codes.name: ReleaseMethodInvalid
codes.message: The task cannot be released from this step with this release method.
codes.hint: Check the step's links and use the release call that matches them (single link, split, or default).

codes.name: AccessDenied
codes.message: The user may not perform this action on this {objectKind}.
codes.hint: Use an account with the needed rights or ask an administrator to grant them.

codes.name: ReadOnly
codes.message: The user has read-only rights here.
codes.hint: Ask for write rights on the drawer or file.

codes.name: FunctionalityRightMissing
codes.message: The functionality right needed for this action is missing.
codes.hint: Check the user's functionality rights.

codes.name: OperationNotAllowed
codes.message: The server does not allow this action on this object or account.
codes.hint: This is a fixed rule, not a missing right; choose a different object or approach.

codes.name: LockedByAnotherUser
codes.message: The {objectKind} is locked by another user.
codes.hint: Wait and retry, or check who holds the lock before acting.

faultPatterns: locked by (another|other|a different) user|is locked by

codes.name: NotLocked
codes.message: The {objectKind} must be locked by you before this call.
codes.hint: Lock it first, make the change, then unlock it.

codes.name: VersionConflict
codes.message: Someone changed the {objectKind} since you read it.
codes.hint: Read it again and reapply your change to the current version.

codes.name: TaskCompleted
codes.message: The task is already completed.
codes.hint: Completed tasks cannot be changed; search for the follow-up task instead.

codes.name: TaskInErrorState
codes.message: The task is in an error or unexpected state.
codes.hint: Inspect the task's error details and fix the cause before releasing or changing it.

codes.name: FileFrozen
codes.message: The file is frozen and cannot be changed.
codes.hint: Unfreeze the file first if you have the right to.

codes.name: HasDependentTasks
codes.message: The {objectKind} still has tasks or diaries attached.
codes.hint: Complete or move the attached tasks first, or use the forced variant if the API offers one.

codes.name: AlreadyDeleted
codes.message: The {objectKind} is already deleted, cut or in deleted content.
codes.hint: Restore it from deleted content first if you need to work with it.

codes.name: SubtasksNotCompleted
codes.message: The task still has open subtasks.
codes.hint: Finish the subtasks before completing or releasing the parent.

codes.name: StepCodeCheckFailed
codes.message: The step's code check rejected the release.
codes.hint: Fix the values the step checks (often task attributes) and release again.

codes.name: NotDeleted
codes.message: The {objectKind} is not marked deleted, so it cannot be restored or purged.
codes.hint: Only deleted objects can be restored; check its status first.

codes.name: InUse
codes.message: The {objectKind} is still in use and cannot be removed.
codes.hint: Remove what depends on it first.

codes.name: InvalidObjectState
codes.message: The {objectKind} is not in a state that allows this action.
codes.hint: Read its current state and bring it to the expected one first.

codes.name: ServerError
codes.message: The ImageRight server failed while handling the request.
codes.hint: Retrying rarely helps; check the server logs or contact the administrator if it persists.

codes.name: DatabaseError
codes.message: The ImageRight server hit a database error.
codes.hint: Retry once after a short wait; if it repeats, the server needs attention.

codes.name: SoapFaultUnmapped
codes.message: The SOAP service returned a fault this server does not recognize.
codes.hint: Read the raw fault in error.native; ir_explain_error can look up the text.

codes.name: NetworkError
codes.message: The ImageRight server could not be reached.
codes.hint: Check the URL, network and TLS settings, then retry.

codes.name: Timeout
codes.message: The request timed out.
codes.hint: Retry reads; for writes, verify the state first because the change may have happened.

codes.name: DataNotReady
codes.message: The server is still preparing the data.
codes.hint: Wait a moment and call again.

codes.name: WorkflowProcessorUnreachable
codes.message: The server could not reach the workflow processor.
codes.hint: Retry later; if it persists the workflow service needs attention.

codes.name: SoapOperationFailed
codes.message: The SOAP operation reported failure in its result.
codes.hint: Read the failure message in error.native and fix the cause before retrying.

codes.name: UpstreamUnmapped
codes.message: The server returned an error code this server does not know.
codes.hint: The native code is kept in error.native; ir_explain_error or the vendor docs may describe it.

codes.name: Internal
codes.message: Something went wrong inside imageright-mcp.
codes.hint: This is a bug in this server, not in your request; please report it with the tool name and arguments.

codes.name: NormalizationFailed
codes.message: The upstream response could not be converted to the standard shape.
codes.hint: The raw response is kept where possible; please report it.
